purpose: Evaluate LIME stability across independent perturbation seeds using the globally selected Stage 13.6A configuration.

selected_configuration.description: Continuous features with a wider local kernel

stability_metrics: Spearman correlation of absolute attribution vectors

operational_stability_categories.High: mean top-10 Jaccard >= 0.75 and mean cosine similarity >= 0.80
operational_stability_categories.Moderate: mean top-10 Jaccard >= 0.50 and mean cosine similarity >= 0.60
operational_stability_categories.Low: does not satisfy the Moderate criteria
operational_stability_categories.warning: These categories are descriptive operational rules for this study, not universal standards.
